verdict.rationale: AMD's own documentation for this exact part gives memory capacity (256 GiB VRAM in the ROCm GPU specs table) and memory type (HBM3, 256GB per accelerator, in the MI325X system acceptance guide). However, the evidence pack contains no bus width or memory bandwidth figure, so only half the requested spec set is published here. Missing for 10: memory bus width, memory bandwidth figure, and independent corroboration of the memory specs.
